upstream_reread_feasibility: Possible only if upstream retains the exact post-mix X row and guarantees a second 256-byte/cycle stream for 80 cycles, with finite flow control and alignment to rstd. Current engine has input-only X stream and no replay request/ready port. Replaying the 4-way HC source instead needs four times that input traffic and repeats the exact mix. No such replay is implemented or credited.
